prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on what you want (UV beds vs spray/tanning booth, price, hours, hygiene, trained techs, etc.). Do you prefer a sunbed tan or a spray tan? If you tell me that and your ZIP or part of Tyler, I’ll give a short list of likely top choices and what to ask when you call.

Until then, quick guidance so you can find the best salon yourself:

How to choose the best tanning salon
- Decide UV beds vs spray (spray tans are far safer — no UV exposure).  
- Check recent online reviews (Google Maps, Yelp, Facebook) and look for comments about cleanliness, consistent results, and service.  
- Look at posted photos (equipment & facility condition).  
- Confirm technician training/certification for spray tans.  
- Ask about equipment age/maintenance and sanitation procedures for beds/booths.  
- Ask what spray product they use (DHA-based, hypoallergenic, organic options) and whether they do patch tests.  
- Compare pricing, packages and cancellation policies.  
- Check for special offers or first-time client discounts.

Questions to ask a salon when you call or visit
- Do you offer spray tans, UV tanning beds, or both?  
- What brands/models of beds and how often are they serviced?  
- What spray tan products do you use? Do you offer custom shade matching?  
- Are technicians certified? Can I see before/after photos and client references?  
- What are your sanitation protocols? How long should I wait between beds?  
- Do you require/offer a patch test for spray tans?  
- What are your prices, packages, and membership options?

Safety reminder
- UV tanning increases skin cancer risk and accelerates skin aging. If you want color but want to minimize risk, choose a professional spray tan. Talk to a dermatologist if you have a history of skin cancer or very fair/fragile skin.

If you tell me your location in Tyler (or whether you want UV vs spray), I’ll give tailored recommendations and what to call first.
